instructions: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C) with a rack in the middle.
Cut the cauliflower into florets about 1 inch wide. Slice the bell pepper and onion thin. Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry.
In a small bowl, mix the cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, garlic powder, black pepper and salt.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower, chickpeas, pepper and onion with the olive oil and the spice mix until everything is coated.
Spread it out in a single layer on two baking sheets. Crowded vegetables steam instead of browning.
Roast for 12 minutes, then toss everything and roast for 10 minutes, until the cauliflower is golden brown at the edges and tender.

While the vegetables roast, put 1 1/2 cups rinsed rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a medium pot. Bring it to a boil, then cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on until you serve.

Make the sauce. Mince the garlic and juice 1 lemon, which should be about 3 tbsp. In a small bowl, stir the tahini, lemon juice and garlic together, then stir in water 1 tbsp at a time until the sauce is thin enough to pour. That should be about 1/4 cup of water.
When the vegetables come out of the oven, squeeze the juice of half the second lemon over them. Cut the rest of that lemon into wedges.
Taste the cauliflower. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the roasted vegetables and the cucumber, and drizzle the tahini sauce over the top. Serve with the lemon wedges.
method_notes: The sheet-pan versions all toss cauliflower with a shawarma spice mix of cumin, paprika, turmeric and cinnamon, roast it hot, and finish with lemon and a tahini sauce. Eating by Elaine adds chickpeas, pepper and onion and roasts at 425°F for 40 minutes; Snixy Kitchen roasts the cauliflower and chickpeas at 450°F in 20 to 25 minutes. This one uses Elaine's vegetables with Snixy's hotter, faster roast, serves them over rice with a tahini and lemon sauce, and leaves out the cayenne so the pan is mild. Neither source has 20 ratings, so it is a fallback lead.
